cards.title: Object Sheet
cards.description: Generates a product reference sheet with 9 views including orthographic angles, natural 3/4 views, and a technical specification panel. Perfect for product design, 3D modeling reference, or catalog documentation.
cards.prompt:
Based on this image:

**OBJECT REFERENCE SHEET — 3×3 GRID (9 VIEWS)**

Generate a professional product reference sheet with 9 views of this object on a [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] cyclorama, arranged in a 3×3 grid.

**OBJECT CONSISTENCY — CRITICAL:**
This is the SAME OBJECT in all 9 views. NOT 9 different objects.
- CLONE exact shape, proportions, details from reference
- CLONE exact materials, colors, textures, surface finish
- CLONE all markings, logos, wear, imperfections
- Scale and details MUST be identical across all views

**3×3 GRID LAYOUT:**

**ROW 1 — ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEWS:**
| FRONT | LEFT SIDE | RIGHT SIDE |

1. **FRONT:** Direct front view, perpendicular to main face
2. **LEFT SIDE:** Perfect 90° profile, left side visible
3. **RIGHT SIDE:** Perfect 90° profile, right side visible opposite view of left side

**ROW 2 — MORE ORTHOGRAPHIC + TOP/BOTTOM:**
| BACK | TOP | BOTTOM |

4. **BACK:** Direct rear view, perpendicular to back face
5. **TOP:** Bird's eye view, looking straight down at object
6. **BOTTOM:** View of underside, object flipped/transparent ground

**ROW 3 — NATURAL VIEWS + TECHNICAL:**
| 3/4 FRONT | 3/4 BACK | TECHNICAL SPEC |

7. **3/4 FRONT:** 45° angle showing front + side, natural product shot angle
8. **3/4 BACK:** 45° angle showing back + side, reveals hidden details
9. **TECHNICAL BOARD:** Clean diagram view with:
   - Estimated dimensions (H × W × D) with dimension lines
   - Material callouts (metal, plastic, fabric, glass, etc.)
   - Key component labels if applicable
   - Scale reference indicator
   - Orthographic side view in black and white

**LIGHTING — PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY STYLE:**
- Soft diffuse lighting from multiple sources
- No harsh shadows — gentle gradients only
- Even illumination revealing all surface details
- Subtle reflections on glossy/metallic surfaces
- Studio product photography quality

**FORMAT — CRITICAL:**
- 3×3 GRID: 9 panels of IDENTICAL width and height
- Visible thin separator lines between panels
- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] background — consistent all panels
- Object centered in each panel with padding
- Same scale across views 1-8 (technical panel may adjust for labels)
- NO TEXT except in Technical Spec panel (panel 9)

**TECHNICAL:**
- Sharp detail on materials, textures, surface quality
- Accurate color representation
- Clean edges, professional product rendering
- Match visual style of reference

SAME OBJECT in all 9 views — consistent in every detail.

cards.title: MASTER CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET
cards.description: Creates a unified 4:3 master character reference board with identity, scale views, expressions, head details, posture, wardrobe callouts, prop notes and hand gestures.
cards.prompt:
Create a single unified MASTER CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET from these inputs:

[STYLE]: [cinematic realism]
[SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION]: [@IMG_1]

Create the board in a 4:3 horizontal layout. The board layout, background, typography and spacing must be clean, neutral, minimal and technical, on a [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] background. Use clear section titles, readable English labels, balanced spacing, no clutter, no watermark, no logo. Apply [STYLE] only to the character and visual elements, not to the board layout or UI. All text must be clearly readable at normal viewing size. Avoid tiny or dense text.

Infer all missing details from the subject description, including name, alias if suitable, role, age, personality, core theme, accent, wardrobe details, accessories, key prop if clearly relevant, visual notes and a fitting color palette.

Use this layout:
top row = left: title + horizontal info block, right: COLOR PALETTE
center = large MAIN IDENTITY + SCALE SHEET as the biggest section
right = EXPRESSION PROGRESSION + HEAD DETAIL SHEET + NEUTRAL BASELINE + POSTURE VARIATION + CLOSE-UP POSE
bottom = WARDROBE / ACCESSORIES DETAILS + PROP + HAND GESTURES

Include:

Title: CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET

1. TOP INFO BLOCK
Name, Alias, Role, Age, Personality, Core Theme, Speech Accent

2. COLOR PALETTE
Place this in the top-right header area.
Show 6 to 8 minimal clean color swatches that match the subject's style, wardrobe, world and mood. Do not add labels.

3. MAIN IDENTITY + SCALE SHEET
This must be the largest and most prominent section.
Show the subject only, with no prop, no bag, no handheld object, no extra item interaction.
Show:
Front, 3/4 View, Side, Back

Place the character views over subtle measurement guide lines, like a clean model sheet scale background with height marks.

Also include a small SILHOUETTE GUIDE inside this same section:
2 small clean silhouette thumbnails, Neutral Stance and Profile Silhouette.
Keep the silhouettes small and secondary, placed in a corner of the MAIN IDENTITY + SCALE SHEET.

The subject should appear in a clean neutral presentation focused only on identity, body shape, outfit, silhouette and proportions.
Add a few small notes for silhouette, posture, special traits, visual identity.

4. EXPRESSION PROGRESSION
Show exactly 8 panels of the same subject:
Neutral, Curious, Worried, Surprised, Afraid, Sad, Determined, Relieved

MICRO EXPRESSIONS
Show exactly 5 panels of the same subject:
subtle eye tension, slight smirk, lip tension, micro fear, controlled breath

These panels should function as both an expression sheet and a light emotional progression.

5. HEAD DETAIL SHEET
Show several close-up head references of the same subject from different angles:
3/4 Headshot, Side Headshot, Top Angle, Low Angle, Diagonal Angle

Keep facial structure, hairstyle, eyes, proportions and identity fully consistent.

6. NEUTRAL BASELINE
1 panel: fully relaxed, no emotion

7. POSTURE VARIATION
2-3 panels: relaxed, tense, confident

8. CLOSE-UP POSE
Show exactly 1 cinematic close-up pose of the same subject from chest-up or shoulder-up.
Use a natural expressive pose that best fits the subject's personality and story tone.
This close-up should clearly show facial identity, hairstyle, expression, upper wardrobe detail and emotional presence.

9. WARDROBE / ACCESSORIES DETAILS
Show exactly 4 close-up callouts for important styling details such as hairstyle, outerwear, footwear, accessories, fabric or material detail.

10. PROP
Only include this section if a prop is clearly important to the subject.
Show exactly 1 single clean isolated image of the prop only.
Add a small info block:
Object Name, Type, Traits

11. HAND GESTURES
relaxed hand, tense fingers, pointing, gripping, subtle gesture near face

Generate a character reference sheet with 4 essential views of this character.

**IDENTITY LOCK — CRITICAL:**
This is the SAME CHARACTER in all 4 views. NOT 4 different people.

- Relaxed standing, weight evenly distributed

- Head straight, neutral expression

- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] background — consistent across all panels
- Visible thin separator lines between panels

- NO TEXT, NO LABELS

- Even, soft lighting from front-top
- Minimal shadows for clarity
- Sharp details, clean edges
- Print-ready quality

SAME CHARACTER in all 4 views — faces and bodies must be identical.

cards.title: Complex Sheet
cards.description: Generates a professional character reference sheet with full-body turnaround and detailed portrait close-ups. Industry-standard layout for character design documentation.
cards.prompt:
Based on this image:

**CHARACTER SHEET — PROFESSIONAL REFERENCE**

Create a professional character reference sheet. Match the EXACT visual style of the reference (realism level, rendering, texture, color treatment, aesthetic).

**IDENTITY LOCK — CRITICAL:**
This is the SAME CHARACTER across ALL 7 panels. NOT different people.
- CLONE exact face: bone structure, features, skin, wrinkles, moles
- CLONE exact body: height, build, proportions
- CLONE exact hair: color, style, length, texture, hairline
- CLONE exact costume: every garment, accessory, detail, wear marks
- Age and ethnicity MUST match source exactly

**LAYOUT — TWO ROWS:**

**TOP ROW — 4 FULL-BODY VIEWS (horizontal):**
| FRONT | LEFT PROFILE | RIGHT PROFILE | BACK |

- FRONT: Facing camera, relaxed A-pose, arms 30-45° from body
- LEFT PROFILE: Perfect 90° facing left, same A-pose
- RIGHT PROFILE: Perfect 90° facing right, same A-pose
- BACK: Facing away, same A-pose

**BOTTOM ROW — 3 PORTRAIT CLOSE-UPS (centered below):**
| FRONT PORTRAIT | LEFT PORTRAIT | RIGHT PORTRAIT |

- FRONT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, facing camera, neutral expression
- LEFT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, 90° profile facing left
- RIGHT PORTRAIT: Head and shoulders, 90° profile facing right

**ALIGNMENT REQUIREMENTS:**
- Full-body views: heads at identical height, same scale
- Portraits: faces at identical scale, same crop level
- Portraits centered beneath full-body row
- Even spacing between all panels
- Clean panel separation with thin lines

**TECHNICAL:**
- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] plain background
- Consistent lighting across ALL panels (same direction, intensity, softness)
- Natural controlled shadows — detail preservation, no dramatic mood
- Sharp details, crisp edges, print-ready quality
- Accurate anatomy, clear silhouettes
- NO TEXT, NO LABELS

SAME CHARACTER in all 7 panels — perfect identity consistency.

cards.title: Basic Expression Board
cards.description: Generates a facial expression reference board with 8 core emotions in a 2×4 grid. Close-up head shots showing the character's acting range.
cards.prompt:
Based on this image:

**FACIAL EXPRESSION BOARD — 2×4 GRID (8 EXPRESSIONS)**

Generate a facial expression reference sheet with 8 different emotions, arranged in a 2×4 grid. Close-up head shots only.

**IDENTITY LOCK — CRITICAL:**
This is the SAME CHARACTER in ALL 8 expressions. NOT 8 different people.
- CLONE exact face from reference: bone structure, nose, eyes, lips, skin texture, moles, scars
- CLONE exact hair: color, style, length, texture (hair may move slightly with expression)
- Age, ethnicity, facial features MUST be identical across all 8 panels
- Only the EXPRESSION changes — the face itself stays the same

**2×4 GRID LAYOUT:**

**ROW 1 (4 expressions):**
| NEUTRAL | HAPPY | SAD | ANGRY |

1. **NEUTRAL:** Relaxed, no emotion, baseline reference face, mouth closed, eyes forward
2. **HAPPY:** Genuine smile, crow's feet, raised cheeks, teeth may show, bright eyes
3. **SAD:** Downturned mouth, drooping eyelids, furrowed inner brows, dejected
4. **ANGRY:** Furrowed brows, tense jaw, flared nostrils, intense glare, clenched teeth

**ROW 2 (4 expressions):**
| SURPRISED | SCARED | DISGUSTED | CONTEMPT |

5. **SURPRISED:** Wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth, shocked expression
6. **SCARED/FEAR:** Wide eyes, raised inner brows, tense mouth, looking alarmed
7. **DISGUSTED:** Wrinkled nose, raised upper lip, squinted eyes, repulsed
8. **CONTEMPT:** Slight smirk, one corner of mouth raised, dismissive, superior look

**FRAMING:**
- Head and upper shoulders visible in each panel
- Face centered, same scale across all 8 panels
- Consistent head angle (slight 3/4 or direct front — same in all)
- Eyes at same height across the row

**FORMAT — CRITICAL:**
- 2×4 GRID: 8 panels of IDENTICAL width and height
- Visible thin separator lines between panels
- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] background — consistent all panels
- NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO EMOTION NAMES
- Same aspect ratio all panels

**TECHNICAL:**
- Consistent soft lighting across all 8 panels (same direction, intensity)
- Sharp detail on facial features, skin texture, eyes
- Expressions must be clear and readable
- Match visual style of reference (realism level, rendering)

SAME FACE in all 8 panels — only the expression changes.

Generate a facial acting reference sheet with exactly 8 close-up portrait panels arranged in a 2×4 grid. Each panel shows the same character performing one selected FACS action unit or compound facial action.

- CLONE exact face from reference: bone structure, nose, eyes, lips, skin texture, moles, scars
- CLONE exact hair: color, style, length, texture
- Age, ethnicity, facial features and face volume MUST be identical across all 8 panels
- Only the FACS facial action changes — no redesign, no beauty correction, no new hairstyle

**SELECTED FACS ACTIONS — USE THESE 8 PANELS IN ORDER:**
[FACS_SELECTION_PLACEHOLDER]

**FACS EXECUTION RULES:**
- Make each facial action readable but anatomically plausible
- Keep all non-selected facial regions neutral unless they are naturally affected by the selected action
- Do not exaggerate into cartoon unless the reference style is already cartoon
- Preserve the same head angle, crop, lens, lighting and background across all panels

**FRAMING:**
- Head and upper shoulders visible in each panel
- Face centered, same scale across all 8 panels
- Consistent head angle, eyes at the same height across each row

**FORMAT — CRITICAL:**
- 2×4 GRID: 8 panels of IDENTICAL width and height
- Visible thin separator lines between panels
- [BG_COLOR_PLACEHOLDER] background — consistent all panels
- NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO AU CODES, NO WATERMARKS

**TECHNICAL:**
- Consistent soft lighting across all 8 panels
- Sharp detail on facial features, skin texture, eyes and mouth shapes
- The result must read like a professional FACS / facial acting reference board

SAME FACE in all 8 panels — only the selected FACS action changes.

lightingTexts.original: **LIGHTING:** Original Scene-Matched — Preserve exact lighting from source: shadow direction/hardness/density, color temperature, atmospheric qualities, specular highlight positions. If mixed lighting (practical + key), preserve ratio. Each view shows how original light wraps around subject from that angle.
lightingTexts.diffuse: **LIGHTING:** Diffuse Studio — Soft global illumination, minimal shadows (only subtle ambient occlusion), neutral daylight 5500-6000K, maximum detail visibility. No crushed blacks or blown highlights. Skin tones even, hair/costume details fully visible. Clinical turntable quality, information over mood.

multiRefTexts.multi:
**MULTI-IMAGE REFERENCE MODE:**
You have been provided with MULTIPLE source images of the same environment from different angles/positions.
- CROSS-REFERENCE all provided images to ensure perfect consistency
- Use visible details from ALL images to reconstruct accurate geometry
- Where images show the same element, it MUST match exactly across your output
- Resolve any ambiguities by finding the element in another reference image
- Color grade must match across all source images — find the common baseline
- This is NOT creative extrapolation — you have the references, USE THEM

subjectTexts.puppet:
**PUPPET/FIGURINE MODE — CRITICAL:**
[IMG_1] is a reference for a practical puppet, figurine, or stylized character.
- Photograph this EXACT figurine with its EXACT proportions as-is
- PRESERVE intentional non-realistic proportions: head size, limb thickness, body shape, joint style
- Do NOT correct toward realistic human anatomy — this is a SCULPTED CHARACTER
- Hands, feet, face may be stylized/simplified — keep them that way
- Adapt clothing to the puppet's specific proportions, not human proportions
- Fabric should drape and fold according to the figurine's unique body shape
- Maintain the sculptural/crafted quality of the original character

accessoryTexts.full:
**POCKET ITEMS & ACCESSORIES (also from knolling board):**
- Include all non-wearable items visible in [IMG_2]: keys, lighter, comb, wallet, phone, cigarettes, cards, coins, etc.
- Place these items logically: in pockets (visible bulge), in hands, clipped to belt, in bag
- If item cannot be worn/carried in pose, place it nearby in scene naturally
